These Terms of Use explain the rules for using Supverify. By creating an account or using the app, you agree to these terms and to the Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not create an account or use the app.

1. What Supverify provides

Supverify helps you record subscriptions, view summaries, save renewal dates, and receive optional reminders. The app is a personal organization tool. It does not process payments, start or cancel subscriptions, negotiate prices, or provide financial, legal, or tax advice.

2. Account and access

You are responsible for providing accurate information, keeping your sign-in credentials private, and all activity performed through your account. Do not share your password or attempt to access another person’s account. We may limit or suspend access when reasonably necessary to protect users, the service, or the security of Firebase resources.

3. Your subscription data

You keep responsibility for the names, prices, dates, categories, currencies, and other information you enter. You grant Supverify the limited permission needed to store, synchronize, display, and process that information to provide the app features. You may edit or delete your subscription records in the app.

4. Reminders and accuracy

Reminders depend on notification permission, Android settings, battery restrictions, network availability, device time, and WorkManager scheduling. Supverify does not guarantee that a reminder will arrive at a particular time. You remain responsible for checking your provider’s official billing information and renewal terms.

The Offers section may contain links, campaigns, prices, or descriptions supplied by or referring to third parties. Information may change, expire, or be unavailable. Supverify is not the seller or provider of those third-party services and is not responsible for their content, availability, pricing, security, or terms. Review the provider’s official page before making a purchase or sharing information.

  • Do not use Supverify unlawfully or to deceive, harm, harass, or impersonate another person.
  • Do not probe, disrupt, reverse engineer, overload, or bypass security controls.
  • Do not upload content that you do not have the right to use or that contains another person’s sensitive information without permission.

7. Privacy and deletion

Our collection and use of information are described in the Privacy Policy. You can request account and associated app-data deletion from Profile → Delete account and data, or through our external deletion page. Deletion is permanent and cannot be undone.

We may change, improve, suspend, or discontinue features. We may update these terms when the app or legal requirements change. The latest version will be published on this page and made available in the app. Continued use after an update means you accept the updated terms.

Supverify is provided for personal organization on an “as available” basis. To the extent allowed by applicable law, we do not promise uninterrupted operation, complete accuracy of third-party information, or delivery of every reminder. Nothing in these terms removes rights that cannot legally be excluded.
